name: Stream Chat
tagline: Realtime chat and messaging API for in-app messaging
description: Stream Chat is a hosted chat and messaging API that provides channels, messages, reactions, moderation, and realtime events for web and mobile apps. Developers use server-side SDKs or the REST API with API keys and user tokens for authentication.

auth.details: API key and secret from the Stream dashboard; client uses API key plus user JWT tokens; server SDKs use API key and secret. Auth typically via stream-auth-type and Authorization headers or SDK config.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Maker plan available with usage limits (confirm current quotas on pricing page)
pricing.paid_plans: Build (free), Start, Elevate, and Enterprise; qualifying small teams may obtain a Maker account

rate_limits: Per endpoint and platform (1-min window); e.g. Query Channels 10,000/min, Send Message 1,000/min; also 60 req/min per user per endpoint/platform. Limits can be dynamically adjusted; higher limits available on request.
use_cases: create a chat channel for a group of users
send a message in a channel
list recent messages in a channel
generate a user token for client auth
moderate or ban a user in chat
